findings.comment: Demolition plan sequence notes (Sheet 8, Block 9) do not address required safety clearances from transmission lines. Missing: (1) pre-construction safety meeting requirement ≥48 hours before work commencement, (2) barricade requirement 10 ft from all transmission structures including guys and anchors, (3) warning signs under overhead transmission facilities, (4) prohibition on materials or spoils storage within transmission easement. These requirements are documented in Sheet 3 (General Notes, Block 20) but must be integrated into the demolition plan sequence notes.

applicableAreas: SCM staging area, Staging and Storage Area located west-central portion near Building 2
findings.comment: SCM staging area (Sheet 5, Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan) is identified and labeled as 'Staging and Storage Area' but no vertical clearance dimension demonstrating the required minimum 14 ft clearance from existing and proposed vegetation and all other objects is labeled. The pond exemption does not apply: combined storage volume is 6,388 cu ft (exceeds 5,000 cu ft threshold) and maximum ponding depth is 3.65 ft (exceeds 3 ft threshold). A vertical clearance dimension and notation must be added.

applicableAreas: maintenance access drive to biofiltration-detention pond, 8' Wide Concrete Maintenance Path and 8' Wide Maintenance Ramp
findings.comment: Maintenance access drive (Sheet 15, Biofiltration-Detention Pond Plan) is shown as '8' Wide Concrete Maintenance Path' and '8' Wide Maintenance Ramp' but no vertical clearance dimension demonstrating the required minimum 14 ft clearance from existing and proposed vegetation and all other objects (including vegetation at maturity) is labeled. The pond exemption does not apply: combined storage volume exceeds 5,000 cu ft and maximum ponding depth exceeds 3 ft. Vertical clearance dimensions and notation must be added.

applicableAreas: site plan sheets showing overhead utilities - western and southern perimeters where OHE lines are present
findings.comment: Site plan and utility plan sheets do not show graphical delineation of overhead electrical clearance envelope boundaries. Missing: (1) graphical representation of the distribution clearance envelope (7.5-ft horizontal sky-to-ground clearance boundary anchored to the outside conductor and 15-ft radial clearance zone from outside conductor), (2) transmission clearance envelope (site-specific analysis required from AE or AE-provided transmission review documentation). Overhead Electric (OHE) lines are shown along the site perimeters but clearance envelopes are not delineated.

applicableAreas: site plan and utility plan sheets where overhead utilities are present
findings.comment: Horizontal dashed height limit lines are not shown on the site plan or utility plan sheets to delineate the clearance envelope boundaries from overhead conductors. Height limit line annotations showing the 7.5-ft horizontal and 15-ft radial clearance limits from the outside conductor must be added to visually represent the overhead utility hazard zone boundaries.

applicableAreas: grading plan and utility plan sheets where overhead utilities exist on sites with sloped terrain
findings.comment: Site has non-uniform grade conditions (topography varies from approximately 678 ft to 687 ft NAVD 88 across the site) with overhead utilities present on western and southern perimeters. No sloped or stepped dashed height limit lines are shown on the grading or utility plan sheets to reflect actual grade changes beneath the overhead conductor span. Sloped or stepped height limit line annotations must be added to account for grade variations.
